title: BCC Ruling No. 15-01-1390 — rooftop patio fire protection and exit route
code_edition: Ontario Building Code, O. Reg. 350/06 (as cited)

facts.text: The record describes a multi-storey complex with office towers, retail and live-event venues connected by a podium; the tallest tower is 13 storeys.
The dispute concerns as-constructed structures for a podium-roof restaurant patio adjacent to existing building windows.

The proposal included rated closures at the windows, fire-retardant treatment of combustible/heavy-timber patio components, and a marked path to an exit; Sentences 3.2.2.23.(2) and 3.2.2.57.(2) are cited.
